question: ‘Machail Mata’ shrine located in the Kishtwar district of Jammu is dedicated to which Goddess?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Durga.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Machail chandi Mata temple** is a** Goddess Durga temple** popularly called as Machail Mata.
 
• It may be noted that **Goddess Durga** is also famous by the name** Kaali or Chandi.**
 
• **Machail Yatra** that occur in the month of August is the best time to visit **Machail Mata Temple. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​Mahalakshmi Temple** is an important Hindu temple dedicated to **Goddess Lakshmi**. 
 
• The** Hidimba temple** is built around a cave where** Devi Hidimba performed meditation**.
 
• **Kalighat Kali Temple **is a Hindu temple in **Kalighat, Kolkata, West Bengal,** India devoted to the Hindu goddess Kali.
